domain_focus: FinCausal financial cause/effect extraction with full proposition/fact endpoints and FIBO semantic grounding.
abstraction_level: annotation-compatible full fact/proposition spans first; exact CAUSE→EFFECT relation second
population_policy: Maximize source-grounded endpoint recall. Preserve complete clauses/sentences, including noisy visible prefixes. Effects are usually quantified financial facts; causes may be qualitative or quantified. Never use textual order to orient causality. Gold remains post-Layer-12 only.
event_modeling_preference: Do not reduce FinCausal endpoints to atomic event triggers; model full fact/proposition chunks.

negative_examples.text: A relation inferred only from world knowledge with no document support.
